jobs.description:
#### **Why join us?**

At Bombardier, we design, build and maintain the world’s peak-performing aircraft for the world’s most discerning people and businesses, governments and militaries. We have been successful in setting the highest standards by putting our people at the heart of it all, and defining excellence, together.

Providing services to Bombardier means operating at the highest level. Every day, you are part of a team that delivers superior experiences and products, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in our industry and beyond. By prioritizing continuous growth and development, we empower everyone to reach their full potential on their own terms, because the greatest results happens when you are free to be yourself and share your unique expertise.

**Flight Control Laws Design, Development and Analysis - Bombardier Fly by Wire Aircraft**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

At Bombardier Aerospace, our employees work together to evolve mobility worldwide - one good idea at a time. If you have a good idea, we’ll provide the environment where it will thrive and grow into a great product or customer experience. Your ideas are our fuel.

The CLaws team is responsible for the design, development, testing and certification of the Fly-by-Wire (FBW) flight control laws for the next generation Bombardier aircraft which at present includes the Global 7000/8000 business jet and the Ecojet Blended Wing body (BWB) experimental aircraft. The CLaws provide a means to manage the aircraft response due to pilot inputs, to reduce pilot workload and to meet the handling quality and performance/structural loads requirements along with providing additional flight and structural envelope protections.

### **What are your contributions to the team?**

* Write requirements for existing experimental model-based CLaws to meet functional requirements and in accordance to the DO-178B standard and SAE ARP 4754
* Perform CLaws validation and verification (V&V) for a new experimental primary flight computer
* If needed, update the Claws design model as well as the corresponding assessment tools using Matlab and C++ programming

### **How to thrive in this role?**

* You must possess a Bachelor or higher degree in Aerospace Engineering
* You must have an understanding of testing methods for model-based CLaws
* You are familiar with the DO-178B standards (or more recent), system requirements verification and validation methods (ARP 4754).
* You should be proficient in using Matlab and Simulink
* You should be proficient in programming Matlab scripts
* You should have an understanding of C/C++ programming
* You must be fluent in written and spoken English
* You must be an innovative team player, self-motivated and able to work independently

Preference will be given to applicants with commercial aircraft experience and additional programming skills such as C++

*Whether your candidacy is moving on to the next step of the hiring process or not, we will keep you informed by email or by phone.* ***Join us at careers.bombardier.com***

***Your ideas move people****.*

#### **Now that you can see yourself with the Bombardier Team!**

Please note: You don’t need all the skills, knowledge, and experience listed to contribute for this opportunities . We’re not seeking perfection, just passionate, committed individuals.

In accordance, Bombardier is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities in connection with access to professional opportunities. Requests for accommodation may be communicated to the Bombardier contact and will be handled confidentially.

Help redefine customer support for the AI era.

Most companies are running support on ticketing systems built in 2007, with AI bolted on as an afterthought.

Botpress is the enterprise-grade AI agent platform for customer support — built the other way around.

As the 3rd fastest-growing B2B AI start-up worldwide, we're displacing legacy platforms like Zendesk at scale — across industries, regions, and thousands of companies worldwide.

The work ahead is ambitious. The opportunity is rare. We take a deliberate approach to growth: product-led, capital-efficient, and highly focused.

If you want to build the customer support platform for the AI era, we're looking for top talent to join us.

**About the Role**

As a Software Developer at Botpress, you'll be at the forefront of developing innovative solutions that drive the future of conversational AI. As part of the engineering team, you'll work closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain scalable applications that enhance the capabilities of our AI agent platform. You'll use your technical expertise to solve complex problems while ensuring the highest standards of code quality and performance.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, and deploy customer-impacting features
* Collaborate with product managers and UX/UI designers to define and implement new features

* Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends to drive innovation within the team

* Proven experience as a Software Engineer or similar role in a fast-paced environment
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and frameworks like React

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to collaborate effectively with team members and stakeholders
* A passion for exploring new technologies and a desire to contribute to a rapidly evolving product

**About Botpress**

Botpress raised a $25 million Series B round in 2025. We're building the enterprise-grade AI agent platform for customer support — not by adding AI to old infrastructure, but by building AI-first from day one.

As a fast-growing start-up, we run a lean and innovative ship that leans on AI for maximum business impact. At Botpress, everyone is an owner, bringing their unique perspective and talents. You'll be on a team that's not just adapting to the AI revolution, but leading it. Joining our team means changing how millions of customers interact with the companies they do business with — and building the platform that defines the next era of customer support.

 **Benefits**  

* 4 weeks of vacation

* Paid sick and parental leave

* Fully-stocked fridge and cupboard – we take snacks seriously
* A meaningful stock option grant — we want everyone at Botpress to think and act as an owner, and to share in what we build
* RRSP program with a 50% employer match on up to 4% of salary
* STM transit subsidy
* A beautiful, fully renovated office
* A vibrant office community including weekly socials

**Faculty / Admin Area:** Faculty of Arts

**Department / Unit:** Office for Arts Education (Foundation Year Program)

**Reports to:** Dean, Faculty of Arts (Lisa Shapiro)

**Classification:** Academic Associate (unranked Contract Academic Staff)

**Status:** Definite term appointment of two years, governed by the Regulations Relating to the Employment of Contract Academic Staff.

**Salary:** Salary will be negotiable, commensurate with qualifications and experience.

**Posting Period:** Review of applications will begin on October 19, 2026; applications will be accepted and reviewed until the position is filled.

**Primary Purpose of the Position**

Reporting to the Dean and working closely with the Director of the Office for Arts Education as well as relevant Associate Deans, the Educational Developer supports the initial implementation of the Foundation Year Program (FYP), with a goal of ensuring stable ongoing operation, including the development of a community of practice around the pedagogy of the FYP. The rank of Academic Associate reflects the academic qualifications required to support pedagogical practices, as well to support other academic activities such as course development. The position combines academic and operational work: it provides coordination to the units, committees, and offices that build and deliver the program, and academic support to instructors of the program. The Educational Developer is a key point of contact for the program development and helps ensure that courses are created, offered, scheduled, and staffed so that students can enrol and progress in its initial years, and helps to build the systems for doing so going forward.

The FYP is the restructured first year for U0 students in the Faculty of Arts, that will serve roughly 800 students in its initial year. The reformed program introduces a set of purpose-built 100-level core courses (one seminar and one lecture per contributing unit), a curated approved list, and a cohort-like first-year experience. The program will launch in Fall 2027. We require added capacity dedicated to academic and administrative coordination in order to launch the revised program successfully and to ensure its sustainability going forward. For additional information regarding the Foundation Year Program revisions, please contact Laura Brassington at laura.brassington@mcgill.ca.

**Duties**

* **Supporting course creation** and administrative processes for 100-level FYP courses (1 seminar and one lecture course per unit)**.**
* **Pedagogical and curricular design.** Provide academic support to the FYP design working group, including developing pedagogical resources, documentation of educational goals and strategies for achieving them, and development of rules for scheduling.
* **Approved List.** Support the curation of the Approved List, coordinating with the Arts Office of Advising and Student Information Services (OASIS), the Office of Arts Education, and other relevant academic offices to build and maintain the list of courses that count toward the approved **l**ist.
* **Course offerings and capacity.** Help build and maintain the mechanisms that ensure enough courses and seats are offered in the first year and in every year after, coordinating with Enrolment Services on classroom space and scheduling.
* **Support instructors.** Communicate with instructors teaching FYP courses to answer questions and to ensure consistency across sections and contributing units.
* **Liaise with** FYP students, in coordination with the Arts Office of Advising and Student Information Services (OASIS).
* **Teaching.** May teach one 100-level FYP course, as appropriate and subject to the relevant terms.

**Qualifications and Expertise Required**

* Doctorate or equivalent in a relevant discipline, consistent with the Academic Associate classification under the Regulations Relating to the Employment of Contract Academic Staff.
* Knowledge of the University's and the Faculty of Arts' academic policies, curriculum processes, and program structures, or ability to learn quickly.
* Strong communication, coordination, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent deadlines and to work autonomously as well as within a team.
* Demonstrated professionalism, discretion, and a service orientation in working with students, instructors, and staff.

**Language**

English spoken and written. French is an asset.

**Required Documents**

The application should include the documents listed below and must be merged into one single PDF file not exceeding 5 MB.

* Cover letter
* Curriculum vitae
* In addition, short-listed candidates will be contacted for three references

At Master, our people are the driving force behind our success. As Canada's largest HVAC-R distributor and one of North America's industry leaders, we're proud to bring together more than 2,000 employees across nearly 100 locations in Canada and the United States.

You'll join the Data Design & Provisioning team, part of the Data Management Services (DMS) department, supporting our Canadian and US entities. Master Group is transitioning from a centralized to a federated data and analytics operating model. The Analyst – Provisioning and Access Control is an operational role responsible for executing data access requests and enforcing access governance rules and policies across the organization's reporting and data platforms.  
This role combines steady operational execution with ongoing foundation-building: the person will execute day-to-day access requests while also helping build and continuously improve the underlying procedures, workflows, and documentation.  
This role applies the data policies and classification rules defined by the Data Governance & Practices team and the access model defined by the Data Design team. When a request is ambiguous, involves sensitive data, or doesn't clearly match an approved pattern, this role escalates to the Data Governance & Practices team before taking any action.  
  
This position can be based anywhere

**What you will accomplish with us:**

Access Provisioning Operations  

* Execute access requests — grant, modify, and revoke — across data platforms & analytics/reporting tools
* Ensure timely and accurate delivery of access in line with documented procedures, policies and classifications
* Source-system access (e.g., Infor SXe, Infor CSD) is out of scope for this role at this time

  
Access Control & Governance Enforcement  

* Apply the access model defined by the Data Design team and the data policies and classification rules defined by the Data Governance & Practices team (this role does not design either)
* Coordinate with the relevant Data Owner to confirm approval on access requests, as Data Owners are identified for each data domain
* Action requests directly when they clearly match a documented, pre-approved pattern
* Escalate to the Data Governance & Practices team before acting on any request that is ambiguous, involves a data classification judgment call (e.g., PII), or does not match a documented pattern — regardless of which way the request appears to lean
* Deny requests that fail procedural checks (e.g., missing approval, no matching approved pattern) and direct the requestor to the correct process

  
Process & Workflow Development  

* Help build and continuously refine the end-to-end access request process, including intake forms, ticketing workflow, and escalation triggers
* Maintain clear documentation of access and provisioning procedures
* Identify and propose access categories that can move to self-service or pre-approved-by-role status over time, reducing the volume requiring manual review
* Contribute to standing up an access audit trail, and — in partnership with the Senior Analyst – Data Design and IT — Power BI access monitoring using available platform tools

  
Monitoring & User Support  

* Monitor access logs and provisioning activity; proactively identify and flag anomalies or issues
* Resolve access-related incidents, coordinating with IT and Data Engineering when technical remediation is needed
* Maintain an audit trail of access changes for traceability
* Support users with guidance on how to request and use data access

**What You Bring to Our Team:**

* 3–5 years of experience in data operations, IT access management, or a data governance-adjacent role
* Experience with data platforms (e.g., SQL Server or equivalent) and BI tools (e.g., Power BI)
* Familiarity with access management processes and role-based access concepts
* Strong attention to detail and process discipline
* Bilingual (English/French) required for Québec-based candidates; English required for candidates based elsewhere in Canada or the United States

  
Compensation Information:  
Base Salary: $75,000 - $85,000 annually  
Supplemental Pay Types Include: Annual bonus

**Competitive Benefits: In addition to a rewarding career within our team, we offer**

  
* Medical and dental coverage from day one, along with short and long-term disability protection
  
* Contribution to a collective registered retirement savings plan upon starting your role.
  
* Wellness spending account
* An employee assistance program including psychological, financial, and legal support.
  
* Access to telemedicine from the beginning of your employment.
  
* Reimbursement of professional association membership fees.
  
* Early vacation program.
  
* Work–life balance supported through a hybrid work policy.

**Faculty / Admin Area:** Faculty of Arts

**Department / Unit:** Office for Arts Education (Foundation Year Program)

**Reports to:** Dean, Faculty of Arts (Lisa Shapiro)

**Classification:** Academic Associate (unranked Contract Academic Staff)

**Status:** Definite term appointment of two years, governed by the Regulations Relating to the Employment of Contract Academic Staff.

**Salary:** Salary will be negotiable, commensurate with qualifications and experience.

**Posting Period:** Review of applications will begin on October 19, 2026; applications will be accepted and reviewed until the position is filled.

**Primary Purpose of the Position**

Reporting to the Dean and working closely with the Director of the Office for Arts Education as well as relevant Associate Deans, the Educational Developer supports the initial implementation of the Foundation Year Program (FYP), with a goal of ensuring stable ongoing operation, including the development of a community of practice around the pedagogy of the FYP. The rank of Academic Associate reflects the academic qualifications required to support pedagogical practices, as well to support other academic activities such as course development. The position combines academic and operational work: it provides coordination to the units, committees, and offices that build and deliver the program, and academic support to instructors of the program. The Educational Developer is a key point of contact for the program development and helps ensure that courses are created, offered, scheduled, and staffed so that students can enrol and progress in its initial years, and helps to build the systems for doing so going forward.

The FYP is the restructured first year for U0 students in the Faculty of Arts, that will serve roughly 800 students in its initial year. The reformed program introduces a set of purpose-built 100-level core courses (one seminar and one lecture per contributing unit), a curated approved list, and a cohort-like first-year experience. The program will launch in Fall 2027. We require added capacity dedicated to academic and administrative coordination in order to launch the revised program successfully and to ensure its sustainability going forward. For additional information regarding the Foundation Year Program revisions, please contact Laura Brassington at laura.brassington@mcgill.ca.

**Duties**

* **Supporting course creation** and administrative processes for 100-level FYP courses (1 seminar and one lecture course per unit)**.**
* **Pedagogical and curricular design.** Provide academic support to the FYP design working group, including developing pedagogical resources, documentation of educational goals and strategies for achieving them, and development of rules for scheduling.
* **Approved List.** Support the curation of the Approved List, coordinating with the Arts Office of Advising and Student Information Services (OASIS), the Office of Arts Education, and other relevant academic offices to build and maintain the list of courses that count toward the approved **l**ist.
* **Course offerings and capacity.** Help build and maintain the mechanisms that ensure enough courses and seats are offered in the first year and in every year after, coordinating with Enrolment Services on classroom space and scheduling.
* **Support instructors.** Communicate with instructors teaching FYP courses to answer questions and to ensure consistency across sections and contributing units.
* **Liaise with** FYP students, in coordination with the Arts Office of Advising and Student Information Services (OASIS).
* **Teaching.** May teach one 100-level FYP course, as appropriate and subject to the relevant terms.

**Qualifications and Expertise Required**

* Doctorate or equivalent in a relevant discipline, consistent with the Academic Associate classification under the Regulations Relating to the Employment of Contract Academic Staff.
* Knowledge of the University's and the Faculty of Arts' academic policies, curriculum processes, and program structures, or ability to learn quickly.
* Strong communication, coordination, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent deadlines and to work autonomously as well as within a team.
* Demonstrated professionalism, discretion, and a service orientation in working with students, instructors, and staff.

**Language**

English spoken and written. French is an asset.

**Required Documents**

The application should include the documents listed below and must be merged into one single PDF file not exceeding 5 MB.

* Cover letter
* Curriculum vitae
* In addition, short-listed candidates will be contacted for three references

This role combines steady operational execution with ongoing foundation-building: the person will execute day-to-day access requests while also helping build and continuously improve the underlying procedures, workflows, and documentation.  
This role applies the data policies and classification rules defined by the Data Governance & Practices team and the access model defined by the Data Design team. When a request is ambiguous, involves sensitive data, or doesn't clearly match an approved pattern, this role escalates to the Data Governance & Practices team before taking any action.  
  
This position can be based anywhere

**What you will accomplish with us:**

Access Provisioning Operations  

* Execute access requests — grant, modify, and revoke — across data platforms & analytics/reporting tools
* Ensure timely and accurate delivery of access in line with documented procedures, policies and classifications
* Source-system access (e.g., Infor SXe, Infor CSD) is out of scope for this role at this time

  
Access Control & Governance Enforcement  

* Apply the access model defined by the Data Design team and the data policies and classification rules defined by the Data Governance & Practices team (this role does not design either)
* Coordinate with the relevant Data Owner to confirm approval on access requests, as Data Owners are identified for each data domain
* Action requests directly when they clearly match a documented, pre-approved pattern

Process & Workflow Development

* Maintain clear documentation of access and provisioning procedures
* Identify and propose access categories that can move to self-service or pre-approved-by-role status over time, reducing the volume requiring manual review
* Contribute to standing up an access audit trail, and — in partnership with the Senior Analyst – Data Design and IT — Power BI access monitoring using available platform tools

  
Monitoring & User Support  

* Monitor access logs and provisioning activity; proactively identify and flag anomalies or issues
* Resolve access-related incidents, coordinating with IT and Data Engineering when technical remediation is needed
* Maintain an audit trail of access changes for traceability
* Support users with guidance on how to request and use data access

new_jobs.description:
Location: Gatineau, QC

**Overview**

Brookfield Renewable is one of the world's largest owners, operators, and developers of renewable power assets. Our Operational Strategy team plays a critical role in advancing the technology, processes, and operational capabilities that support Brookfield's North American Trading, Marketing, Scheduling, Risk, and Energy Management organizations.

Reporting to the Director, Operational Strategy, the Business Analyst serves as a key liaison between business stakeholders, technology teams, and operational groups. This role is responsible for identifying opportunities to improve business processes, leading system implementations and enhancements, supporting operational excellence initiatives, and delivering data-driven solutions that enable scalable growth across Brookfield's renewable energy portfolio.

The successful candidate combines strong business analysis skills with operational understanding, analytical capabilities, and a passion for process improvement and technology-driven transformation.

**Key Responsibilities**

Business Analysis & Solution Delivery

* Partner with stakeholders across Trading, Marketing, Scheduling, Settlements, Asset Management, Operations, and Risk Management to identify business needs and improvement opportunities.
* Lead requirements gathering sessions, workshops, interviews, and process reviews.
* Prepare Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Business Concept Documents (BCDs), user stories, process maps, and functional specifications.
* Translate business requirements into actionable system and process solutions.
* Challenge assumptions and help stakeholders identify optimal approaches to achieve business objectives.
* Document current-state ("As-Is") and future-state ("To-Be") business processes.

Process Improvement & Operational Excellence

* Identify process inefficiencies, operational risks, control gaps, and manual workarounds.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on automation, scalability, efficiency, and reliability.
* Assess impacts of organizational, regulatory, and business changes on operational processes.
* Develop recommendations to improve controls, audit readiness, compliance, and reporting capabilities.
* Support operational maturity initiatives and standardization efforts across business functions.

Systems & Technology

* Support enhancement, implementation, and optimization of:
* + ETRM platforms
  + Scheduling and transmission systems
  + Data platforms and reporting solutions
  + Workflow and automation tools
  + Integration solutions between internal and external systems
* Investigate system issues and coordinate resolution activities with business and technology teams.
* Participate in solution design reviews and validation activities.
* Support configuration testing and deployment activities.

Data & Analytics

* Analyze operational, financial, and transactional data to identify trends, issues, and opportunities.
* Develop data-driven insights that support decision-making.
* Support reporting, KPI development, operational dashboards, and management reporting.
* Perform root-cause analysis using available data sources.
* Collaborate with technical teams to define data requirements and validation criteria.

Testing & Change Management

* Develop testing strategies, test plans, and test cases.
* Coordinate and lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Validate delivered functionality against business requirements.
* Support stakeholder communications, training, and change management activities.
* Ensure operational readiness prior to production deployments.

Documentation & Knowledge Management

* Maintain business process documentation, procedures, training materials, and knowledge repositories.
* Ensure documentation remains accurate, current, and audit-ready.
* Contribute to the creation and maintenance of operational knowledge bases and self-service resources.

Innovation & Automation

* Identify opportunities to leverage emerging technologies, AI solutions, advanced analytics, and automation platforms.
* Support initiatives involving Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform, workflow automation, and modern collaboration tools.
* Participate in strategic projects that improve operational efficiency and business scalability.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field.
* Minimum 3-5 years of experience in Business Analysis, Process Improvement, Operations, Energy Markets, Technology Delivery, or a related discipline.
* Strong experience gathering, documenting, and validating business requirements.
* Demonstrated experience analyzing complex business processes and designing practical solutions.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting energy trading, risk management, scheduling, settlements, or power operations.
* Experience with ETRM platforms and energy market applications.
* Familiarity with North American electricity markets, transmission, scheduling, and renewable energy operations.
* Experience with:
* + SQL
  + Power BI
  + Alteryx
  + Python
  + Databricks
  + Power Platform
  + Microsoft Copilot and AI-enabled business solutions
  + Workflow automation platforms
* Experience supporting system integrations and API-based solutions.
* Understanding of audit, compliance, SOX controls, or operational governance frameworks.
* Experience working within Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid project delivery methodologies.

**Key Competencies**

* Strategic thinker with strong business acumen.
* Highly analytical and detail-oriented.
* Process improvement mindset.
* Strong ownership and accountability.
